{{Top|leg}}
'''Godon Frezzes''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that came in a wrapper. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] recommended a Godon Frezzes wrapper as a good source of wadable material to create a "[[micronite]]" explosive charge.
